 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Nov 02, 2026, 01:15 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print On this Monday, Aries wakes up feeling unusually quiet. During the night, the Moon in Cancer drew a trine to Shani in Pisces, which is a good influence between your fourth house of family and your twelfth house of rest. This influence also continues until the morning hours. Now the Moon is located in Ashlesha in Cancer, still next to the challenging Mars, so Aries must keep calm through the afternoon. Moon Trine Shani
 The trine aspect is easy. The influence is between the fourth and the twelfth houses and implies that the night has been restful and quiet at home. Use the morning to decide on plans for the upcoming week, when the mind is calm and thoughtful. Ashlesha and Mars after Noon
 Ashlesha, which is ruled by Mercury and connected to the snake, can provoke harsh words at times of stress. With difficult Mars next to the Moon in the fourth house, there might be family arguments in the evening. It is important to think of the calmness of the morning and leave the room if the shouting starts. Somvar and Shiva
 Monday is the day of the Moon and of Shiva. A quick visit to the Shiva temple after sunset will help reduce Mars’ restlessness. Partners and the Seventh House Your seventh house is still influenced by a retrograde Mercury and also by gradually recovering Venus near the weak Sun, so talks with partners should be light this week. Do’s for Today
 Use early tranquillity to plan the week ahead.
 Leave the situation if voices rise.
 Don’ts for Today
 Do not make fast decisions on Monday.
 Do not let afternoon stress spoil morning calm.
 Shani Remedy for the Day
 Recite Chandra Kavach in the morning and donate a thermos to a night-shift security guard.
